name: nika
description: Author, debug, operate and migrate AI workflows as checkable .nika files. Bundles 5 skills, 5 subagents, 2 rules, 14 commands (/check, /explain, /compile, /trace, /permits, /doctor, /make, /run, /pending, /ideas, /capture, /report, /improve, /connect), 3 hooks on every surface — Cursor, Claude Code and Codex (one dialect, sniffed) (session context, check-on-edit, a guard that audits before any nika run) and the read-only Nika MCP oracle (9 tools). Requires the nika binary: brew install nika-open/tap/nika. /make, /run, /pending, /report, /improve and /connect call helper scripts through the Claude Code plugin root; on Cursor each of them says how to do the same step with the nika binary alone
